title: Kirby Problem 5.2
exact_target: Must a recurrent homeomorphism with uniformly bounded orbits be trivial, and must a recurrent homeomorphism of a ball fixing its boundary be trivial?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3009 (KP-5.2). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 5.2, author preliminary version.
